prompt: Which North Atlantic tropical storm, whose peak intensity remained at tropical storm level, caused the highest number of deaths last year?
answer: **Tropical Storm Barry** caused the most deaths in the 2025 North Atlantic season among storms that never exceeded tropical-storm strength, with **8 fatalities**. Its peak intensity was **45 kt (50 mph / 85 km/h)**.
